title: Academic Writing Task 2: Opinion on University Process Transparency
prompt: Some universities publish detailed step-by-step guides explaining how academic decisions such as grading, appeals, and progression are made. Others argue that such processes should remain internal to staff to preserve flexibility and professional judgment. To what extent do you agree or disagree that universities should make their academic processes fully transparent to students? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目中的观点明确表达你的立场（同意或不同意），并给出理由和相关例子。注意：不要描述图表或数据，而是围绕“大学是否应完全公开学术流程”展开论证。字数不少于250词。
